def program(n):
    """convert long to signed 32 bit integer"""
    n = n & 0xFFFFFFFF  # TARGET_A
    return (n ^ 0x80000000) - 0x80000000
cases.human_guard_note: For an unsigned 32-bit value the mask is the identity; outside that window it changes the intermediate.

def program(data):
    data = sorted(data)  # TARGET_A
    n = len(data)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return data[n // 2]
    i = n // 2
    return data[i - 1]
cases.human_guard: (len(data) == 2 and data[0] == min(data)) or (len(data) == 3 and (count(data, data[1]) >= 2 or (min(data) != data[1] and max(data) != data[1])))
cases.human_guard_note: Sorting is unobservable for two points when the first is already the minimum, and for three points when the middle element is the median: either it is tied with another point, or it is neither the unique minimum nor the unique maximum. All subterms are total on length 2..3, which the non-short-circuiting guard language requires.
